children: Overview
UK science and tech investor's HY26 NAV/share grew 3.2%, driven by Pfizer obesity asset progress
Company reported HY26 profit of £31.2 mln, reversing prior-year loss
Cash proceeds from exits in HY26 reached £68.7 mln, surpassing FY25 total
Outlook
IP Group targets more than £250m of exits by end-2027
Company expects value-driving milestones across portfolio over next 18 months
Company sees supportive environment for science and technology investments
Result Drivers
PFIZER OBESITY ASSET - £27m uplift in Pfizer Obesity Royalty Income asset valuation following positive clinical progress and reduced development risk
EXIT PROCEEDS - Cash proceeds from exits reached £68.7m, with major contributions from Monolith, Hinge Health, and Centessa exits
PORTFOLIO FUNDRAISING - Portfolio companies raised £543m from third parties, which the company says validates portfolio quality
